title: 量化金融，从零搭建 · 第37部分：市场冲击与执行

chapters.Hook: 百分之十花三十个基点；百分之四十花多少？
chapters.House: 9. 第37条规则：交易之前先定价
chapters.Research: 写给研究者：暂时性冲击下的最优执行时间表
chapters.Outro: 回顾、交易台问题与习题

6d104ba01ceb.en: Part thirty-seven. Market impact and execution: how much a large order moves the price against the trader who sends it, and how to send it so that it costs the least.
6d104ba01ceb.zh: 第37部分。市场冲击与执行：一笔大订单会让价格朝不利于下单者的方向移动多少，以及怎样下单才能让成本最低。

7da39352eae3.en: A question asked of execution traders. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose buying a tenth of a day's volume has thirty basis points of terminal impact. What would four tenths imply? <bookmark mark='b'/> Linear scaling says a hundred and twenty. <bookmark mark='c'/> Holding the empirical square-root prefactor and volatility fixed gives 60: twice the terminal price displacement for four times the size. This extrapolation is a model illustration, especially at such large participation. Terminal impact is different from the average execution shortfall paid while the order builds.
7da39352eae3.zh: 执行交易者常遇到这样的题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设买入日成交量十分之一，终点冲击为三十个基点；买入十分之四会怎样？<bookmark mark='b'/> 线性缩放给出一百二十。<bookmark mark='c'/> 固定经验平方根系数与波动率，则得到60，数量四倍而终点位移两倍。如此大的参与比例尤其需要把它视为模型外推。终点冲击不同于订单执行过程中实际支付的平均执行差额。

f01a1d88d70f.en: What this part finds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Across ten public Bitcoin trade-date files, the binned same-minute signed-volume association has slope 0.81; it does not identify a parent order's causal cost. In the chosen latent-book discretization, the fitted large-order slope is 0.42. <bookmark mark='b'/> Optimal schedules are theorems under specified models: Almgren and Chriss for mean-variance risk, and Obizhaeva and Wang for exponential resilience. <bookmark mark='c'/> In a separate random stream of the same fitted simulator, Q-learning costs 52.7 total half-ticks against TWAP's 50.7. This comparison is simulation, with no real-market deployment claim.
f01a1d88d70f.zh: 本部分的发现。<bookmark mark='a'/> 十个公开比特币成交日期文件中，同分钟方向成交量与价格的分箱相关斜率是0.81，并不识别母订单的因果成本。选定潜在簿离散模型的大订单拟合斜率为0.42。<bookmark mark='b'/> 最优时间表是在指定模型下的定理：Almgren与Chriss处理均值方差风险，Obizhaeva与Wang处理指数恢复。<bookmark mark='c'/> 同一个拟合模拟器的另一随机流中，Q学习总成本为52.7个半跳，TWAP为50.7。这是模拟比较，没有实盘部署结论。

1568faaad274.en: Why it matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> A strategy's capacity depends on the size at which execution costs consume expected alpha; earlier parts used a square-root approximation for that trade-off. <bookmark mark='b'/> For sufficiently large orders, impact can dominate fees and spreads, although this varies by market and regime. <bookmark mark='c'/> Brokers' algorithms, cost analysis and routing all try to manage this bill and the uncertainty around it.
1568faaad274.zh: 为什么重要。<bookmark mark='a'/> 策略容量取决于执行成本何时吞掉预期超额收益；此前用平方根近似描述这个权衡。<bookmark mark='b'/> 对足够大的订单，冲击可能超过价差与费用，但具体取决于市场与状态。<bookmark mark='c'/> 经纪商算法、成本分析与路由都试图控制这笔账单及其不确定性。

1464d0ffa18c.en: Three beliefs to examine. <bookmark mark='a'/> Impact and spread are separate components, and their relative sizes depend on the order. <bookmark mark='b'/> Slicing always helps: a size-only square-root formula holds terminal impact fixed when duration changes, but actual rate dependence, information leakage, liquidity and risk still matter. <bookmark mark='c'/> And one cheap execution proves skill: random price moves can dominate one order's shortfall. Judge suitable groups of orders, preserving uncertainty and selection effects.
1464d0ffa18c.zh: 检查三种看法。<bookmark mark='a'/> 冲击与价差是不同成本，相对大小取决于订单。<bookmark mark='b'/> 拆单总有帮助：仅含规模的平方根公式在改变时长时保持终点冲击不变，但速率、信息泄露、流动性与风险仍重要。<bookmark mark='c'/> 一次便宜执行就证明技巧：随机价格变动可能主导单笔差额。应对适当订单组进行评价，同时保留不确定性与选择效应。

2e9f5da98df4.en: Where this sits. Part thirty-five asked who trades with whom; Part thirty-six opened the order book. This part sends a large order through it, and Part thirty-eight sits on the other side, as the market maker who absorbs it.
2e9f5da98df4.zh: 这一部分的位置。第35部分问的是谁与谁交易；第36部分打开了订单簿。这一部分把一笔大订单送进订单簿，而第38部分坐在另一边，作为吸收它的做市商。

984592b7a4aa.en: Fifty years of the subject. Alan Kraus and Hans Stoll measured the impact of block trades in 1972; André Perold defined implementation shortfall; Dimitris Bertsimas and Andrew Lo, then Robert Almgren and Neil Chriss, posed execution as optimal control. <bookmark mark='a'/> Then the propagator, Jim Gatheral's no-dynamic-arbitrage conditions, the square-root law measured across markets, and Obizhaeva and Wang's resilient book. <bookmark mark='b'/> And latent liquidity, microstructure invariance, and reinforcement learning.
984592b7a4aa.zh: 这个领域的五十年。克劳斯和斯托尔在1972年测量大宗交易冲击；佩罗尔德定义执行差额；贝尔齐马斯与罗，以及阿尔姆格伦与克里斯，把执行写成最优控制问题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 随后是传播子、加瑟拉尔的无动态套利条件、跨市场平方根经验规律，以及奥比扎耶娃与王江的恢复订单簿。<bookmark mark='b'/> 再后来是潜在流动性、微观结构不变性与强化学习。

261dc7f9ae24.en: The plan: metaorders and what public data shows; the square-root law and latent liquidity; the propagator; which impact models are allowed; Almgren and Chriss, then Obizhaeva and Wang; a learned executor, the algorithms brokers sell, and transaction-cost analysis; and the optimal schedule under transient impact, proved.
261dc7f9ae24.zh: 计划如下：元订单以及公开数据能显示什么；平方根法则与潜在流动性；传播子；哪些冲击模型是被允许的；Almgren和Chriss，然后是Obizhaeva和Wang；一个学习型执行者、券商出售的算法和交易成本分析；最后证明暂时性冲击下的最优时间表。

f1b7411b9a87.en: In the House, the execution desk opens: it receives every order the portfolio desks send, schedules it, and reports what it cost.
f1b7411b9a87.zh: 在本系列公司里，执行台开张了：它接收组合台发来的每一笔订单，为它安排时间表，并报告它花了多少成本。

0dafbb7c1134.en: Chapter one. No institution buys a large position in one order. It splits the decision into hundreds or thousands of child orders over hours or days. The whole is called a metaorder, and its cost is the subject of this part.
0dafbb7c1134.zh: 第1章。没有哪家机构会用一笔订单建立大头寸。它把一个决定拆成成百上千个子订单，分布在数小时或数天里。这整体叫作元订单，它的成本就是这一部分的主题。

d5f9cf6b366b.en: The vocabulary. <bookmark mark='a'/> A parent order of total size Q is sent as child orders. <bookmark mark='b'/> Realized participation divides Q by the market volume during execution; specify whether that denominator includes our own trades. <bookmark mark='c'/> Signed terminal displacement is the end-minus-start price in the order's direction. That observable contains market news and other traders' flow as well as any mechanical impact, so displacement alone is not a causal estimate.
d5f9cf6b366b.zh: 先明确术语。<bookmark mark='a'/> 总量Q的母订单拆成子订单。<bookmark mark='b'/> 实际参与率是Q除以执行期间市场成交量，必须说明分母是否包含自己的成交。<bookmark mark='c'/> 带方向终点位移是交易方向乘终点减起点价格，包含市场消息、他人流量及可能的机械冲击。只看位移并不是因果估计。

c4554fe8389c.en: How cost is measured for a buy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Perold's implementation shortfall compares executed shares with a paper portfolio at the decision price, plus an explicitly chosen terminal mark for unfilled shares. The displayed formula excludes fees until added separately; sells require the signed convention. <bookmark mark='b'/> Delay, execution, timing and opportunity are accounting and modeling decompositions. A public tape does not separately identify mechanical impact from news. <bookmark mark='c'/> For large orders impact may dominate commissions, but the comparison must use consistent dollars or basis points.
c4554fe8389c.zh: 以买入为例衡量成本。<bookmark mark='a'/> Perold执行差额比较真实成交与决策价格的纸面组合，并为未成交部分明确指定终端标价。展示公式尚未包含费用；卖出需要使用方向约定。<bookmark mark='b'/> 延迟、执行、时机与机会成本是会计及模型分解。公开成交不能把机械冲击与消息影响分别识别。<bookmark mark='c'/> 大订单冲击可能超过佣金，但必须比较一致的美元或基点单位。

1b4418ff2080.en: An illustrative shape reported in some metaorder studies. <bookmark mark='a'/> During execution, average signed displacement can rise concavely. <bookmark mark='b'/> Afterwards it may partially revert. Moro and colleagues, and Bershova and Rakhlin, discuss such decay; the fraction and measurement horizon depend on conditioning and the sample. The two-thirds level here is illustrative, not a universal permanent fraction. The trader pays an average of fill prices rather than the terminal peak, and price reversion does not directly allocate a third of the order's total cost.
1b4418ff2080.zh: 这是部分母订单研究报道的示意形状。<bookmark mark='a'/> 执行期间平均方向位移可能凹形增加。<bookmark mark='b'/> 之后可能部分回撤。Moro等以及Bershova与Rakhlin讨论这类衰减，比例与观察时限取决于条件和样本。图中的三分之二是示意，不是普遍永久比例。交易者支付平均成交价而非终点峰值，价格回撤不能直接把总成本的三分之一归为纯成本。

c28b0abb4dde.en: Who is on the other side. <bookmark mark='a'/> Sellers receive the transaction prices a buyer pays, but the difference from a benchmark is not automatically their net profit; hedging, inventory risk and subsequent prices matter. <bookmark mark='b'/> Reversion can be consistent with liquidity provision, while persistent displacement can reflect information or correlated future trading. This is an economic interpretation, not an identified decomposition. <bookmark mark='c'/> Kyle's specific equilibrium gives linear permanent pricing of order flow; richer models allow concavity and transience.
c28b0abb4dde.zh: 另一方是谁。<bookmark mark='a'/> 卖方收到买方支付的成交价，但相对基准的差额并不自动成为卖方净利润；对冲、库存风险及后续价格都重要。<bookmark mark='b'/> 回撤可能符合流动性供给解释，持续位移也可能来自信息或未来相关交易。这是经济解释，不是已识别分解。<bookmark mark='c'/> Kyle的特定均衡给出线性永久流量定价；更丰富的模型允许凹性和暂时性。

4e5a6ffbbd93.en: What we can measure. <bookmark mark='a'/> Parent-order links usually require brokers' or funds' records. The public aggregate-trade tape does not identify those parents. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here aggregate impact means the conditional association of a window's signed volume with its price change, using all traders together. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ten date files from May 2023 yield 14,390 one-minute intervals and mean recorded volume about 374 thousand bitcoin per file. These are recorded spans, not an assertion of complete daily coverage; partial files and gaps affect day normalization.
4e5a6ffbbd93.zh: 能够测量什么。<bookmark mark='a'/> 母订单关联通常需要经纪商或基金记录，公开归集成交不提供这种关联。<bookmark mark='b'/> 此处总体冲击指所有交易者合计的窗口方向成交量与价格变化的条件相关。<bookmark mark='c'/> 2023年5月十个日期文件得到14390个一分钟区间，平均每文件记录约374千个比特币。这是记录跨度，不宣称每日完整覆盖；部分文件和缺口会影响日归一化。

55bd7fc347f5.en: How researchers see metaorders at all. <bookmark mark='a'/> Proprietary records, a broker's or a fund's own child orders linked to their parents: the gold standard. <bookmark mark='b'/> Leaked account data, as from the Mt. Gox exchange. <bookmark mark='c'/> Or proxies from the tape, such as runs of same-sign trades or broker codes: noisy, and biased toward the orders that were easy to spot.
55bd7fc347f5.zh: 研究者到底怎么看到元订单。<bookmark mark='a'/>专有记录，即券商或基金自己与母订单关联的子订单：这是黄金标准。<bookmark mark='b'/>泄露的账户数据，比如来自Mt. Gox交易所的数据。<bookmark mark='c'/>或者从成交记录中找代理变量，比如同方向成交的连串或券商代码：噪声大，而且偏向那些容易被发现的订单。

b0e990fb8099.en: Aggregate flow and prices on Bitcoin. <bookmark mark='a'/> For ten-second, one-minute and five-minute windows, plot conditional mean price change against buy-minus-sell volume divided by their sum. Days are pooled with bin-count weights, using the nearest populated center. <bookmark mark='b'/> These finite bins suggest a saturating pattern; Patzelt and Bouchaud discuss related associations. The largest one-minute bin mean is about 101 ticks. This is same-window association with no causal intervention, held-out forecast or robust uncertainty band, and a flat conditional mean is not a hard limit on price moves.
b0e990fb8099.zh: 比特币总体流量与价格。<bookmark mark='a'/> 对十秒、一分钟和五分钟窗口，将条件均值价格变化对买卖量差除以总量作图。按分箱计数加权合并日期，使用最近的有数据中心。<bookmark mark='b'/> 有限分箱提示饱和形状，Patzelt与Bouchaud讨论过类似相关。一分钟最大分箱均值约101跳。这是同窗口相关，没有因果干预、独立样本预测或稳健误差带；条件均值变平不代表价格变化存在硬上限。

52592b031b3b.en: And against absolute net volume. <bookmark mark='a'/> Group minutes by the magnitude of their signed volume, then show median magnitude and mean price change multiplied by its sign, on logarithmic scales. The smallest bin is excluded from the slope fit. <bookmark mark='b'/> The resulting finite-bin slope is 0.81, between one half and one in this sample. No parent orders are identified, and no confidence interval establishes a universal exponent. It is a descriptive contemporaneous association, distinct from the causal execution cost of one metaorder.
52592b031b3b.zh: 再看净量绝对值。<bookmark mark='a'/> 按方向成交量的大小分组，绘制绝对量中位数及价格变化乘流量方向的均值，使用对数坐标。斜率拟合排除最小箱。<bookmark mark='b'/> 有限分箱斜率为0.81，本样本介于二分之一与一之间。没有识别母订单，也没有置信区间证明普遍指数。这是同时发生的描述性相关，不等于单笔母订单的因果执行成本。

5115459d9f85.en: Quantitative pause one. One percent of daily volume has terminal displacement ten basis points. Keeping the model inputs fixed, compute the four-percent and nine-percent values under square-root and linear scaling.
5115459d9f85.zh: 数值暂停题一。日成交量百分之一的终点位移是十个基点。固定模型输入，分别计算百分之四与百分之九在平方根及线性缩放下的位移。

4ff931b644bd.en: The pause answer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Four times the size gives twice the terminal displacement, twenty basis points. <bookmark mark='b'/> Linear scaling gives forty. <bookmark mark='c'/> Be careful with units: average price shortfall per share grows with the square root of total size. For a path c times root q, integrating execution prices gives total impact cost two-thirds c Q to the three-halves, and average cost two-thirds c root Q. It is displacement divided by total quantity that decreases, not cost per share.
4ff931b644bd.zh: 暂停题解答。<bookmark mark='a'/> 四倍数量给出两倍终点位移，即二十个基点。<bookmark mark='b'/> 线性缩放为四十。<bookmark mark='c'/> 小心单位：每份平均价格差额随总规模的平方根增加。若路径为c乘q的平方根，积分成交价格得到总冲击成本三分之二c乘Q的一点五次方。平均成本是三分之二c乘Q的平方根。下降的是位移除以数量，不是每份成本。

66da1a110448.en: Chapter two. The most robust empirical regularity in market microstructure, and a puzzle about why it holds. Then a model of hidden liquidity that explains it.
66da1a110448.zh: 第2章。市场微观结构中最稳健的经验规律，以及一个关于它为什么成立的谜。然后是一个解释它的隐藏流动性模型。

7be69bcfff33.en: The empirical approximation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Terminal signed price impact is often modeled as Y times daily return volatility times the square root of order size over daily volume. Use matching base-volume units for Q and V. Loeb, Torre, Almgren and colleagues, and Toth and colleagues document related patterns. <bookmark mark='b'/> Y is calibrated for the measurement convention and sample; it is not a universal constant. <bookmark mark='c'/> The displayed size-only formula omits duration and participation. Those variables can matter in richer impact surfaces, and the same Y cannot be assumed for terminal displacement and average execution cost.
7be69bcfff33.zh: 经验近似。<bookmark mark='a'/> 母订单带方向终点冲击通常建模为Y乘日收益波动率，再乘订单量占日成交量比例的平方根。Q和V必须使用一致的基础数量单位。Loeb、Torre、Almgren等与Toth等记录过相关规律。<bookmark mark='b'/> Y依赖测量约定和样本校准，不是普适常数。<bookmark mark='c'/> 只含规模的公式省略时长和参与率，更丰富的冲击曲面中这些变量可能重要，终点位移与平均执行成本不能默认共用Y。

679e36b2883f.en: How universal. <bookmark mark='a'/> Across thousands of stocks and dozens of futures, exponents near one half over several decades of size. <bookmark mark='b'/> On Bitcoin, Jonathan Donier and Julius Bonart reconstructed about a million metaorders from the account-level records leaked from the Mt. Gox exchange, and found a square root there too. <bookmark mark='c'/> With limits: very small orders show linear impact, some data fit a logarithm better, and the prefactor varies.
679e36b2883f.zh: 有多普适。<bookmark mark='a'/>在数千只股票和数十种期货上，在跨越好几个数量级的规模上，指数都接近二分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>在比特币上，Jonathan Donier和Julius Bonart从Mt. Gox交易所泄露的账户级记录中重建了约一百万个元订单，也发现了平方根。<bookmark mark='c'/>也有局限：非常小的订单表现出线性冲击，有些数据用对数拟合更好，前因子也会变化。

2c35d28fbf5b.en: An illustrative extrapolation for Bitcoin, setting Y to one. <bookmark mark='a'/> A tenth of a percent of mean recorded volume, about 10 million dollars at the reference price, gives terminal displacement about 5 basis points. <bookmark mark='b'/> One percent gives 17. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ten percent gives 54. The daily volatility here is a square-root-of-1440 extrapolation of minute volatility, while volume is mean recorded file volume; incomplete spans and intraday seasonality limit this calibration. These are model outputs, not measured executions or average shortfalls.
2c35d28fbf5b.zh: 令Y为一，对比特币作示意外推。<bookmark mark='a'/> 平均记录成交量的千分之一，以参考价格约10百万美元，对应终点位移约5基点。<bookmark mark='b'/> 百分之一为17。<bookmark mark='c'/> 百分之十为54。日波动率是分钟波动率乘一千四百四十的平方根，成交量则取文件记录均值；不完整跨度与日内季节性限制这种校准。这些是模型输出，不是真实执行或平均差额。

a755e7ccf902.en: Why is it a puzzle? <bookmark mark='a'/> Kyle's model gives a straight line. A square root means the market absorbs large orders more cheaply than any fixed depth would. <bookmark mark='b'/> The visible book is no help: it holds a tiny fraction of a day's volume, and a metaorder of one percent would empty it many times over. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the liquidity must be latent: traders who would buy or sell at some price, and reveal it only when the price comes near.
a755e7ccf902.zh: 为什么这是个谜？<bookmark mark='a'/>Kyle的模型给出直线。平方根意味着市场吸收大订单比任何固定深度都更便宜。<bookmark mark='b'/>可见的订单簿帮不上忙：它只容纳一天成交量的很小一部分，一笔百分之一的元订单会把它清空很多次。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以流动性必然是潜在的：那些愿意在某个价格买或卖、但只在价格靠近时才显露出来的交易者。

b859ea581f4d.en: Dimensions organize assumptions but do not determine a square-root law. <bookmark mark='a'/> If volume share and normalized duration are the only chosen variables, normalized impact can be a function of them; other liquidity and market scales may enter. <bookmark mark='b'/> Dropping duration is an empirical approximation, not a consequence of units. <bookmark mark='c'/> A heuristic adds both diffusive price risk and liquidity supply proportional to elapsed time, then eliminates time. Those added assumptions suggest a square root. Dimensional consistency alone leaves the function undetermined.
b859ea581f4d.zh: 量纲组织假设，却不能决定平方根规律。<bookmark mark='a'/> 如果只选择成交量占比与归一化时长，归一化冲击可以是它们的函数；其他流动性和市场尺度也可能进入。<bookmark mark='b'/> 省略时长是经验近似，不是单位推出的结论。<bookmark mark='c'/> 启发式还加入扩散价格风险和随时间线性供给的流动性，再消去时间；这些附加假设提示平方根。仅有量纲一致仍不能确定函数。

88a91e9f337f.en: What the visible comparison actually measures. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ten bitcoin is a rounded illustrative scale for the two best queues, not full displayed depth across all levels. <bookmark mark='b'/> Against mean recorded trade-file volume of 374 thousand bitcoin, <bookmark mark='c'/> this is 0.003 percent. Quotes refresh and deeper orders may exist, so this ratio is not a count of how many times a metaorder must empty the full book. Latent liquidity is one model of replenishment and hidden intentions, not an inference established by the ratio alone.
88a91e9f337f.zh: 可见深度比较实际测量什么。<bookmark mark='a'/> 十个比特币是两个最优队列的取整示意尺度，不是所有档位完整深度。<bookmark mark='b'/> 相对平均每文件记录374千个比特币，<bookmark mark='c'/> 这个比例为0.003个百分点。报价会更新，也可能存在更深挂单，不能据此算出母订单必须耗尽全簿多少次。潜在流动性是一种补充与隐藏意图模型，不是这个比例独立证明的结论。

2d0e246284e7.en: The picture of latent liquidity. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hidden intentions to buy below the price and to sell above it. Jonathan Donier, Julius Bonart, Iacopo Mastromatteo and Bouchaud showed that if these latent orders keep arriving, being cancelled and revising their prices at random, the density near the price is a V: it grows linearly with the distance from the price. <bookmark mark='b'/> A buyer must eat the offers between the old price and the new one: a triangle.
2d0e246284e7.zh: 潜在流动性的图像。<bookmark mark='a'/>价格之下隐藏的买入意愿和价格之上隐藏的卖出意愿。Jonathan Donier、Julius Bonart、Iacopo Mastromatteo和Bouchaud证明，如果这些潜在订单不断到达、被撤销并随机修改价格，那么价格附近的密度呈V形：随着离价格的距离线性增长。<bookmark mark='b'/>买方必须吃掉旧价格和新价格之间的所有卖单：一个三角形。

cff9a2e33c1d.en: A static triangular-book calculation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assume nonnegative offer density L times distance from the old price. <bookmark mark='b'/> Buying every offer up to delta consumes one half L delta squared. <bookmark mark='c'/> Invert to obtain delta equal to the square root of two Q over L. This assumes a static linear profile over the whole consumed region; the dynamic latent model requires a separate argument. <bookmark mark='d'/> A proposed scaling L proportional to daily volume divided by daily variance introduces a calibration constant and matching time conventions. Units permit it but do not establish it.
cff9a2e33c1d.zh: 静态三角形订单簿计算。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设非负卖方密度等于L乘距旧价格的距离。<bookmark mark='b'/> 买到delta需要消耗二分之一L乘delta平方。<bookmark mark='c'/> 反解得到delta等于二Q除以L的平方根。这假设整个消耗区域都静态线性；动态潜在模型需要另外论证。<bookmark mark='d'/> 提出L正比日成交量除以日方差，还需校准常数及匹配时间约定。单位允许它，却不建立这个比例。

e985e92a97a4.en: Now the unchanged finite-difference latent-book simulation: fixed execution duration, diffusion, finite boundaries and a source near the zero of density. <bookmark mark='a'/> A log fit to the four smallest sampled orders gives slope 1.02. <bookmark mark='b'/> The four largest give 0.42. These are finite-grid fits, affected by source placement and boundaries, and are not a convergence proof of one half. The static triangle is a reference curve; the small-to-large crossover is qualitatively related to Bucci and colleagues' empirical discussion.
e985e92a97a4.zh: 现在看未改动的有限差分潜在簿模拟：固定执行时长、扩散、有限边界以及密度零点附近的源。<bookmark mark='a'/> 四个最小取样订单的对数拟合斜率为1.02。<bookmark mark='b'/> 四个最大的为0.42。这些是受源放置和边界影响的有限网格拟合，不是二分之一指数的收敛证明。静态三角形只作参照，大小订单交叉与Bucci等的经验讨论定性相关。

b8e4cfc9e45d.en: The same simulated order stops near time one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its sampled price reaches 8.8, <bookmark mark='b'/> then falls to 3.7 by the end of the recorded path. A diffusion model on an effectively unbounded linear profile can have slow inverse-root decay; this finite horizon and fixed-boundary discretization do not establish that asymptotic rate. Persistent real-market displacement may involve information or future correlated trading, neither included in this illustration.
b8e4cfc9e45d.zh: 同一个模拟订单在时间一附近停止。<bookmark mark='a'/> 取样价格达到8.8，<bookmark mark='b'/> 在记录末尾降至3.7。有效无界线性密度上的扩散模型可能有缓慢反平方根衰减，但有限时限和固定边界离散化不能证明该渐近速率。真实市场持续位移可能包含信息与未来相关交易，这个示例都未纳入。

d778eecb3161.en: A conditional fair-pricing calculation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assume an execution path c root q, with no separate spread or fees. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its quantity-weighted average displacement is two-thirds of the terminal peak. <bookmark mark='c'/> If one additionally imposes Farmer and colleagues' fair-pricing relation that the eventual conditional price equals this average fill price, two-thirds remains. That relation is an equilibrium modeling assumption; it is not implied by the square root alone or by a generic assertion that neither side profits.
d778eecb3161.zh: 有条件的公平定价计算。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假定执行路径为c乘q平方根，没有另外价差或费用。<bookmark mark='b'/> 按数量加权的平均位移为终点峰值三分之二。<bookmark mark='c'/> 若额外施加Farmer等的公平定价关系，使最终条件价格等于平均成交价，便剩余三分之二。这是均衡模型假设，不是平方根单独推出，也不能仅凭双方不获利的泛泛说法建立。

002b23887758.en: A different scaling hypothesis. <bookmark mark='a'/> Trading activity W is volatility times dollar volume, with units and reference scales fixed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Kyle and Obizhaeva's invariance motivates a number B of bets per day proportional to relative activity to the two-thirds power. <bookmark mark='c'/> In a reduced business-time representation, order size in bets is Q B over V, and volatility per bet is daily volatility divided by root B. Thus normalized impact includes a B to the minus one-half prefactor as well as a function of size in bets. This schematic representation needs calibration; invariance alone does not force that function to be a square root.
002b23887758.zh: 另一种缩放假说。<bookmark mark='a'/> 交易活跃度W是波动率乘美元成交量，要固定单位与参考尺度。<bookmark mark='b'/> Kyle与Obizhaeva的不变性提示每日押注数B正比相对活跃度的三分之二次方。<bookmark mark='c'/> 简化业务时间表示中，以押注计的订单量为QB除以V，每次押注波动为日波动率除以B平方根。因此归一化冲击除了押注规模的函数，还包含B的负二分之一次方前因子。这个示意需要校准；不变性本身不强迫函数为平方根。

bf14c7a305d4.en: Quantitative pause two. A static offer density is L times distance from the old price, with L equal to two units per tick squared. A buyer consumes nine units. Integrate the triangle and find the displacement in ticks.
bf14c7a305d4.zh: 数值暂停题二。静态卖方密度等于L乘距旧价格的距离，L为二单位每跳平方。买方消耗九单位。积分这个三角形，计算以跳为单位的位移。

f4b56c2ebbdd.en: Chapter three. A linear transient-impact model can reconcile persistent order signs with diffusive returns by a decaying kernel, under explicit scaling assumptions. That is one possible mechanism rather than a unique inference about efficient prices. We will distinguish the observed response function from a finite fitted projection and its illustrative superposition.
f4b56c2ebbdd.zh: 第三章。在明确缩放假设下，线性暂时冲击模型可用衰减核调和持续订单方向与扩散收益。这只是可能机制，不是市场效率的唯一解释。区分观测响应函数、有限线性投影及其示意叠加。

0468fda0d48e.en: The model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Price is represented by a convolution of earlier trade signs with a lag kernel, plus noise under specified stationarity and convergence assumptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> The response is an unconditional signed average over all starting trades, not simply the conditional move after a buy unless additional symmetry holds. It includes correlated later flow and news. <bookmark mark='c'/> A theoretical long-memory sign process has autocorrelation proportional to lag to minus gamma, with gamma between zero and one. A short fitted range does not establish that asymptotic law.
0468fda0d48e.zh: 模型。<bookmark mark='a'/> 在指定平稳性和收敛假设下，将价格表示为先前成交方向与滞后核的卷积，加噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/> 响应是对所有起始交易的无条件带方向平均，并不自动等于买入后的条件位移，除非有额外对称性；它包含后续相关流量与消息。<bookmark mark='c'/> 理论长记忆符号过程的相关正比滞后的负gamma次方，gamma介于零与一之间。短区间拟合不能证明这种渐近规律。

c0d748d14998.en: Measured on 3,429,887 aggregate-trade records from four date files. The mid comes from a 100-millisecond quote grid: the code selects the second preceding grid index, clips at available boundaries, and concatenates days after removing overnight price jumps. <bookmark mark='a'/> The signed response reaches about 14 ticks at sampled lag 500. <bookmark mark='b'/> Later sampled values bend down. This is descriptive, with no robust uncertainty interval or causal intervention; stale snapshots, partial spans and joins can affect it.
c0d748d14998.zh: 四个日期文件共有3429887条归集成交记录。中价来自一百毫秒报价网格，代码取第二个先前索引，并在边界截断；消去隔夜跳跃后拼接日期。<bookmark mark='a'/> 取样滞后500处带方向响应达到约14跳。<bookmark mark='b'/> 后面的取样值向下弯。这是描述性结果，没有稳健置信区间或因果干预；陈旧快照、不完整跨度与拼接都会影响它。

ca49a5f49711.en: A finite linear projection. <bookmark mark='a'/> The unchanged code uses centered signs, a thousand-lag Toeplitz correlation system and cumulative coefficients. The inferred kernel peaks at 0.72 ticks at lag 77. This projection does not causally isolate one trade. <bookmark mark='b'/> A log regression over lags one hundred to one thousand, flooring kernel values at a small positive number, gives decay estimate 0.17. Omitted state, finite truncation and regularity assumptions remain; no uncertainty interval or out-of-sample forecast is supplied.
ca49a5f49711.zh: 有限线性投影。<bookmark mark='a'/> 未改动代码使用中心化符号、一千阶Toeplitz相关系统及系数累加，所得核在滞后77达到0.72跳。投影不因果隔离单笔交易。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在一百至一千滞后做对数回归，将核值截到一个很小的正数，得到衰减估计0.17。遗漏状态、有限截断及正则性假设仍存在，没有误差区间或样本外预测。

13e5a2559dc6.en: An illustrative superposition through the fitted kernel. Add one positive impulse every five trade-clock units for six hundred units, then stop. <bookmark mark='a'/> Summing shifted sampled kernels gives the displayed normalized path; its final value is about 86 percent of the peak. This is an algebraic counterfactual holding the fitted kernel and other flow fixed. It does not simulate an interacting parent order, measure executable fills or establish a universal post-trade fraction.
13e5a2559dc6.zh: 将拟合核作示意叠加。每五个成交时间单位加入一次正冲量，持续六百单位后停止。<bookmark mark='a'/> 累加平移的取样核得到归一化路径，末值约为峰值的86个百分点。这个代数反事实固定拟合核与其他流量，并不模拟会相互作用的母订单、不测量可执行成交，也不证明普遍的交易后比例。

920fd4f698ff.en: Three limitations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Aggregate-trade records merge same-price taker fills; a multilevel sweep may produce several records. <bookmark mark='b'/> Several records can share a stale quote snapshot, and the lookup uses the second preceding grid index rather than a message-level pretrade quote. <bookmark mark='c'/> Four date files include a weekend, partial recorded spans and artificial event-time joins. One average fit can mix regimes, and it provides neither causal identification nor a robust confidence band.
920fd4f698ff.zh: 三个限制。<bookmark mark='a'/> 归集成交合并同价吃单，多档扫单可能产生多条记录。<bookmark mark='b'/> 多条记录可共用陈旧快照，查询取第二个先前网格索引，而非逐笔成交前报价。<bookmark mark='c'/> 四个日期包含周末、不完整记录及人工事件时间连接。平均拟合可能混合状态，不能给出因果识别或稳健误差带。

60f0e632153c.en: The conditional scaling argument. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assume a stationary long-memory sign process with exponent gamma, a regular power-law propagator with beta, and a well-defined return construction. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the relevant scaling regime, the correlated-flow contribution has variance exponent two minus gamma minus two beta. <bookmark mark='c'/> Equating it to one gives beta equal to one minus gamma over two. Diffusive variance alone is weaker than a martingale or absence of predictability, and an additional noise term may matter. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our finite-lag estimates are 0.17 and 0.10. Their numerical proximity is not a statistical validation of asymptotic efficiency.
60f0e632153c.zh: 有条件的缩放论证。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设平稳长记忆符号过程指数为gamma，规则幂律传播子指数beta，并有定义良好的收益构造。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在相关缩放区间，流量贡献的方差指数为二减gamma减二beta。<bookmark mark='c'/> 令其为一，得到beta等于一减gamma再除二。扩散方差弱于鞅或不可预测，额外噪声项也可能重要。<bookmark mark='d'/> 有限滞后估计为0.17与0.10，数字接近不是渐近效率的统计验证。

509b1e85e4fe.en: What this model can say. <bookmark mark='a'/> Past correlated flow can be encoded through a lag kernel, while surprise models encode unexpected signs directly. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a regular power-law kernel with beta between zero and one, a fixed-rate stream has impact growing roughly as time to one minus beta in its scaling range. <bookmark mark='c'/> At fixed duration a linear convolution is linear in the stream's amplitude, so it cannot by itself produce a square root in size across amplitudes. Changing duration along with quantity can change the apparent exponent; the experimental comparison must hold the right variables fixed.
509b1e85e4fe.zh: 模型可以说什么。<bookmark mark='a'/> 滞后核可以编码历史相关流量，惊讶模型则直接编码未预期方向。<bookmark mark='b'/> beta介于零与一的规则幂律核下，固定速率流在缩放区间内冲击近似按时间的一减beta次方增加。<bookmark mark='c'/> 固定时长时线性卷积对流量幅度线性，不能单独产生幅度之间的平方根规模关系。若同时改变数量与时长，表面指数会变化，比较必须固定恰当变量。

cf384591eb33.en: Two ways to say it. <bookmark mark='a'/> The transient impact model of this chapter: every trade's impact decays by a fixed kernel. <bookmark mark='b'/> Or history-dependent impact: only the surprise in each sign moves the price, so an expected trade costs little. Lillo and Farmer called it asymmetric liquidity: the side that is expected to be hit fills up. <bookmark mark='c'/> Both reconcile predictable flow with unpredictable prices; they differ in what they predict for a single trader's metaorder.
cf384591eb33.zh: 两种说法。<bookmark mark='a'/>本章的暂时性冲击模型：每笔成交的冲击按一个固定的核衰减。<bookmark mark='b'/>或者历史依赖冲击：只有每个方向中的意外成分推动价格，所以预期之中的成交几乎没有成本。Lillo和Farmer称之为不对称流动性：预期会被打的一侧会被填满。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者都调和了可预测的订单流与不可预测的价格；它们的区别在于对单个交易者的元订单作何预测。

1add3c765365.en: Quantitative pause three. Assume sign exponent gamma equals point six and the flow variance scaling exponent is two minus gamma minus two beta. Find beta for linear variance growth, and explain why this alone does not prove unpredictable returns.
1add3c765365.zh: 数值暂停题三。假设gamma为零点六，流量方差幂指数为二减gamma减二beta。求使方差线性增长的beta，并解释为什么这本身不证明收益不可预测。

0fe14af7818f.en: Chapter four. A box-shaped decay kernel can give a suitably timed multi-leg round trip negative expected model cost. A simple buy, wait, sell pair is not enough for a nonincreasing kernel; the counterexample needs the interactions of several legs. The requirement is to examine the whole quadratic cost functional under the model's trading and self-impact conventions.
0fe14af7818f.zh: 第四章。方框衰减核可能使适当定时的多腿往返产生负预期模型成本。非增核下，简单买入、等待、卖出两腿还不够；反例需要多腿相互作用。必须在指定交易及自身冲击约定下检查完整二次成本泛函。

136d2e91ccdc.en: The setting is deterministic signed finite-variation trading against linear transient impact and a martingale unaffected price. <bookmark mark='a'/> The causal price contains earlier trades. <bookmark mark='b'/> Expected impact cost uses the symmetric double integral, including half the self-impact of a block. Spread, fees, risk and any predictive drift are omitted. <bookmark mark='c'/> A zero-total round trip should have nonnegative expected cost. This is a model consistency condition, distinct from an executable risk-free arbitrage in a market with frictions.
136d2e91ccdc.zh: 设定是确定性带符号有限变差交易，线性暂时冲击，以及未受影响的鞅价格。<bookmark mark='a'/> 因果价格包含先前交易。<bookmark mark='b'/> 预期冲击成本使用对称双重积分，包含整块自身冲击的一半；省略价差、费用、风险及预测漂移。<bookmark mark='c'/> 总量零的往返应有非负预期成本。这是模型一致性条件，不同于有摩擦市场中可执行的无风险套利。

96531341851b.en: First, permanent impact. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose trading at rate v moves the price permanently by f of v. <bookmark mark='b'/> Gur Huberman and Werner Stanzl showed that unless f is linear, buying fast and selling slowly, or the reverse, makes money. <bookmark mark='c'/> And with linear permanent impact the cost is one half kappa X squared whatever the schedule: it cannot be optimised away. Only the transient part depends on how one trades.
96531341851b.zh: 首先，永久冲击。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设以速率v交易会让价格永久移动f(v)。<bookmark mark='b'/>Gur Huberman和Werner Stanzl证明，除非f是线性的，否则快买慢卖，或者反过来，就能赚钱。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在线性永久冲击下，无论时间表如何，成本都是二分之一kappa乘X的平方：它无法被优化掉。只有暂时性的部分取决于怎样交易。

46cf85d13da9.en: An odd nonlinear permanent-rate illustration, f of v equals v times absolute v. <bookmark mark='a'/> Buys and sells therefore move prices in opposite directions. <bookmark mark='b'/> Buy one unit at rate one for time one: displacement rises from zero to one and average purchase displacement is one half. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sell it back at rate minus one tenth for time ten: displacement falls to point nine and average sale displacement is point nine five. <bookmark mark='d'/> With no spread, fees or noise, expected sale proceeds exceed purchase cost by point four five. Merely ending flat at a higher price would not have established profit; comparing the integrated cash flows does.
46cf85d13da9.zh: 奇函数永久速率示例：f(v)等于v乘绝对v。<bookmark mark='a'/> 因此买卖使价格朝相反方向移动。<bookmark mark='b'/> 以速率一买入一单位、持续时间一，位移从零升至一，平均购买位移为二分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/> 以负十分之一速率在十个时间单位卖回，位移降至零点九，平均卖出位移零点九五。<bookmark mark='d'/> 没有价差、费用和噪声时，卖出收入超过买入成本零点四五。只知道空仓时价格更高还不能证明利润，必须比较积分现金流。

303a501b7750.en: A box kernel lasting three-tenths of the horizon. <bookmark mark='a'/> The unchanged code takes its most negative eigenvector, removes the mean so the trades sum to zero, and normalizes total absolute turnover to one. This constructs a candidate; it does not solve the exact constrained cheapest-round-trip problem. <bookmark mark='b'/> The candidate cost is -0.06 per unit absolute turnover, negative in this frictionless linear model. Spread and other costs are omitted, but the kernel has failed this model consistency check.
303a501b7750.zh: 持续期限十分之三的方框核。<bookmark mark='a'/> 未改动代码取最负特征向量，减均值使交易总和零，再将绝对换手归一到一。这构造一个候选，不是严格解约束下最便宜往返。<bookmark mark='b'/> 候选成本为每单位绝对换手-0.06，在无摩擦线性模型下为负。虽然省略价差及其他成本，核已经未通过这一模型一致性检查。

e2edb439cd58.en: Positive definiteness and round trips require a distinction. <bookmark mark='a'/> A nonnegative quadratic cost for every signed trading measure is the positive-definite condition. It is sufficient for nonnegative costs of zero-total round trips; the latter alone is conditional positive definiteness on the zero-mass subspace. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a continuous even kernel, Bochner's theorem represents positive definiteness by a nonnegative spectral measure. An ordinary Fourier density requires additional integrability or an appropriate generalized interpretation. <bookmark mark='c'/> The box transform changes sign, and our explicit zero-total candidate has negative cost. Decaying exponentials and shifted power laws with positive parameters provide useful positive-definite families.
e2edb439cd58.zh: 要区分正定与往返。<bookmark mark='a'/> 对所有带符号测度二次成本非负就是正定条件，足够保证总量零往返非负；仅往返非负是在零质量子空间上的条件正定。<bookmark mark='b'/> 对连续偶核，Bochner定理用非负谱测度刻画正定性；普通傅里叶密度需要额外可积性或合适的广义解释。<bookmark mark='c'/> 方框变换有负区间，而且已经构造出负成本零总量候选。正参数衰减指数和平移幂律是有用的正定模型族。

df6451e6954c.en: A stronger schedule property. <bookmark mark='a'/> Under the relevant nonnegative, decreasing, convex-kernel hypotheses and well-posed trading problem, purchase optima can be chosen without intermediate sales. <bookmark mark='b'/> Positive definiteness alone does not guarantee this property. Some positive-definite kernels permit lower-cost purchases that include sales, called transaction-triggered manipulation. This differs from a negative-cost round trip. <bookmark mark='c'/> A Gaussian kernel is positive definite but concave near zero and illustrates the distinction on a finite grid; nonconvexity alone does not force every optimum to oscillate.
df6451e6954c.zh: 更强的时间表性质。<bookmark mark='a'/> 在非负、递减、凸核及适定交易问题的相关假设下，买入最优策略可不含中间卖出。<bookmark mark='b'/> 仅正定不足以保证这种性质；某些正定核允许包含卖出的更便宜买入策略，称为交易触发操纵。这不同于负成本往返。<bookmark mark='c'/> 高斯核正定但原点附近凹，在有限网格说明区别；非凸本身不强迫所有最优解振荡。

9e465aff5b3f.en: The Gaussian kernel on eleven grid dates. <bookmark mark='a'/> The unconstrained numerical optimizer buys 3.27 units and sells 2.27 back, net one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its model cost is 0.129 versus the equal-slice cost 0.145. Intermediate sales show transaction-triggered manipulation in this model, not a negative round-trip cost. A desk that requires monotone execution needs suitable kernel assumptions or an explicit no-sales constraint.
9e465aff5b3f.zh: 十一日期网格上的高斯核。<bookmark mark='a'/> 无符号约束数值优化器买入3.27、卖出2.27，净量一。<bookmark mark='b'/> 模型成本0.129，相同切片成本0.145。中间卖出说明此模型中的交易触发操纵，不是负往返成本。若交易台要求单调执行，就需适当核条件或明确禁止卖出的约束。

2cf25532d5ee.en: Refining the Gaussian grid produces increasingly large cancelling trades. <bookmark mark='a'/> At twenty-one dates the largest computed trade is about 13,033 units for net quantity one. But fine Gaussian matrices are severely ill-conditioned: these floating-point solves are numerical illustrations, not a proof of the continuum infimum or nonexistence. Strict positivity on each distinct finite grid does not guarantee coercivity or attainment over all signed finite measures. Keep analytical existence results separate from this table.
2cf25532d5ee.zh: 细化高斯网格会产生越来越大的抵消交易。<bookmark mark='a'/> 二十一日期时，为了净买一单位，最大计算单笔约13033单位。但细高斯矩阵严重病态，浮点求解是数值示意，不证明连续极限下确界或不存在性。各有限网格严格正定也不保证所有有限带符号测度上的强制性或达到最小。应把解析存在性结论与此表区分。

5b7709379d8f.en: Now a chosen positive-parameter surrogate, not the unrestricted measured kernel. <bookmark mark='a'/> Use one plus lag over the fitted peak scale, raised to minus the positive fitted exponent 0.17. This removes the initial rising section and imposes a functional family. <bookmark mark='b'/> That family is decreasing and convex for positive scale and exponent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Its even extension satisfies Polya's positive-definite criterion and appropriate no-intermediate-sale results. This validates properties of the chosen model, not a proof that the observed market or raw fitted kernel is free of manipulation.
5b7709379d8f.zh: 现在是选定的正参数代理模型，不是无约束测得核。<bookmark mark='a'/> 采用一加滞后除拟合峰值尺度，再取负拟合指数0.17次方；它去掉初始上升段并施加函数族。<bookmark mark='b'/> 正尺度、正指数时该族递减且凸。<bookmark mark='c'/> 偶延拓满足Polya正定准则及相关无中间卖出结论。这验证所选模型性质，不证明真实市场或原始拟合核无操纵。

c654f06a6086.en: Lessons for model use. <bookmark mark='a'/> Check the quadratic cost functional and distinguish round-trip positivity, strict convexity, existence and monotone execution. <bookmark mark='b'/> Positive-parameter exponential and shifted-power-law families satisfy useful sufficient conditions; that does not validate their empirical calibration. <bookmark mark='c'/> With nonlinear instantaneous impact inside a transient kernel, Gatheral's no-manipulation restrictions require explicit rate, decay and admissibility assumptions. They are not a license to combine arbitrary concave impact and exponential decay.
c654f06a6086.zh: 使用模型的教训。<bookmark mark='a'/> 检查二次成本，区分往返正性、严格凸性、存在性与单调执行。<bookmark mark='b'/> 正参数指数和平移幂律满足有用充分条件，但这并不验证经验校准。<bookmark mark='c'/> 对瞬时非线性与暂时核结合的模型，Gatheral无操纵限制需要明确速率、衰减与可行策略假设，不能任意拼接凹冲击和指数衰减。

375ca01002a5.en: Quantitative pause four. A box kernel equals one for lags below tau and zero afterwards, with unit self-impact. Trade plus one, minus one, plus one, minus one, spaced point seven tau apart. Compute net quantity, absolute turnover and the quadratic cost. Ignore spread and fees.
375ca01002a5.zh: 数值暂停题四。方框核在滞后小于tau时为一，之后为零，自冲击为一。按零点七tau间隔交易加一、减一、加一、减一。计算净量、绝对换手与二次成本，忽略价差费用。

b38ee04202d8.en: Chapter five. A deterministic mean-variance execution model trades expected temporary cost against price risk. Its risk-averse seller front-loads relative to TWAP under the stated positive effective-cost coefficient. Robert Almgren and Neil Chriss made this trade-off explicit; the answer depends on the model's clock, risk preference and calibration.
b38ee04202d8.zh: 第五章。确定性均值方差执行模型权衡预期暂时成本与价格风险。有效暂时成本系数为正时，风险厌恶卖方相对TWAP提前执行。Almgren与Chriss把权衡写清楚；答案依赖时钟、风险偏好与校准。

cfded16a4857.en: The discrete model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Unaffected price innovations are independent, zero mean and unit variance, with sigma in price per square root of the chosen time unit. Sales add linear permanent displacement. <bookmark mark='b'/> Execution has linear temporary rate cost, and a specified interval convention for when noise is borne. <bookmark mark='c'/> Deterministic holdings fall from X to zero. The displayed mean-variance formulas match that convention; they are not identities for arbitrary adaptive execution or jump processes.
cfded16a4857.zh: 离散模型。<bookmark mark='a'/> 未受影响价格创新独立、零均值、单位方差；sigma是每平方根所选时间单位的价格波动，卖出增加线性永久位移。<bookmark mark='b'/> 执行有线性暂时速率成本，并规定区间内何时承担噪声。<bookmark mark='c'/> 确定性持仓从X降至零。均值方差公式匹配该时点约定，不适用于任意自适应执行或跳跃过程。

3feb5c0e459d.en: The objective. <bookmark mark='a'/> Expected shortfall has permanent term one half gamma X squared and temporary term eta-tilde over tau times squared trades, where eta-tilde equals eta minus gamma tau over two. Require eta-tilde positive for this strictly convex discrete problem. <bookmark mark='b'/> The variance uses post-trade holdings under the implemented noise convention, sigma squared tau times their squared sum. <bookmark mark='c'/> Minimize expected dollars plus lambda times squared-dollar variance, with nonnegative lambda. Lambda therefore has units inverse dollars.
3feb5c0e459d.zh: 目标。<bookmark mark='a'/> 预期差额有二分之一gamma乘X平方的永久项，以及eta波浪除以tau乘交易量平方和的暂时项；eta波浪等于eta减gamma tau的一半。这个严格凸离散问题要求eta波浪正。<bookmark mark='b'/> 依实现的噪声时点约定，方差为sigma平方tau乘成交后持仓平方和。<bookmark mark='c'/> 最小化预期美元加lambda乘美元平方方差，lambda非负且单位为每美元。

577252443e27.en: The solution. <bookmark mark='a'/> Differentiation gives the displayed second-difference equation with coefficient lambda sigma squared over eta-tilde. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its exact grid solution is a hyperbolic sine with cosh kappa tau equal to one plus lambda sigma squared tau squared over twice eta-tilde. <bookmark mark='c'/> The continuous small-step approximation is kappa equal to root lambda sigma squared over eta. One over kappa is an e-folding time, not an exact half-life. In a long-horizon exponential approximation the half-life is log two over kappa; for a finite sinh path it must be solved from the path itself.
577252443e27.zh: 解。<bookmark mark='a'/> 求导得到二阶差分方程，系数lambda sigma平方除以eta波浪。<bookmark mark='b'/> 精确网格解为双曲正弦，其中cosh kappa tau等于一加lambda sigma平方tau平方除以二eta波浪。<bookmark mark='c'/> 连续小步长近似kappa等于lambda sigma平方除以eta的平方根。其倒数是e倍时间，不是精确半衰期。长时限指数近似的半衰期为log二除以kappa；有限sinh路径则需从路径本身求解。

743e4f733e10.en: The same answer in continuous time, by Part eight's calculus of variations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Minimise the integral of the cost of speed, eta times the rate squared, plus the cost of risk, lambda sigma squared times the holding squared. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Euler-Lagrange equation is a particle pulled toward zero by a spring. <bookmark mark='c'/> With the order full at the start and empty at the end, the solution is the hyperbolic sine.
743e4f733e10.zh: 用第8部分的变分法，在连续时间里得到同样的答案。<bookmark mark='a'/>最小化速度成本（eta乘速率的平方）与风险成本（lambda乘sigma平方乘持仓的平方）之和的积分。<bookmark mark='b'/>欧拉-拉格朗日方程描述一个被弹簧拉向零的粒子。<bookmark mark='c'/>开始时满仓、结束时清空，解就是双曲正弦。

6ee9f2bebafe.en: An illustrative sell of five thousand bitcoin over sixty one-minute intervals. Volatility is obtained from minute price changes in the recorded trade spans. Temporary eta is inferred from a contemporaneous signed-volume bin by a half-move heuristic, not causally estimated execution cost. <bookmark mark='a'/> With zero risk aversion the model gives TWAP. <bookmark mark='b'/> Increasing lambda front-loads the displayed schedules. The shapes illustrate this assumed model; they are not validated forecasts of market-order costs.
6ee9f2bebafe.zh: 示意卖出五千比特币，分六十个一分钟区间。波动率取记录跨度内分钟价格变化，暂时eta用同时方向成交量箱及半位移启发式推断，不是因果执行成本估计。<bookmark mark='a'/> 无风险厌恶给出TWAP。<bookmark mark='b'/> 增大lambda使时间表前置。形状说明所假设模型，不是市场订单成本的验证预测。

3a482e7887ff.en: The model's efficient frontier. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each point is a deterministic schedule's expected temporary cost against its shortfall standard deviation. The plotted family begins at a very small positive lambda, not exact zero; exact TWAP is the lambda-zero reference. <bookmark mark='b'/> Front-loading exchanges higher modeled mean cost for lower modeled variance. Near the minimum-cost schedule the first cost change is second order, while risk can fall at first order. The conclusion holds within the stated deterministic mean-variance setting.
3a482e7887ff.zh: 模型有效前沿。<bookmark mark='a'/> 每点是确定性时间表的预期暂时成本与差额标准差。曲线从很小的正lambda开始，并非精确零；精确TWAP是零lambda参考。<bookmark mark='b'/> 前置以更高模型均值成本交换更低模型方差。在最小成本时间表附近，一阶成本变动为零，而风险可一阶下降。结论限定于所述确定性均值方差设定。

b3f3f9f88471.en: The model numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Equal slices cost 21 thousand dollars, 1.6 basis points, with standard deviation 267 thousand. <bookmark mark='b'/> At lambda ten to minus six, modeled cost is 35 thousand and standard deviation 178 thousand. <bookmark mark='c'/> The continuous urgency approximation has e-folding time 19 minutes. This is not the exact finite-horizon half-life; the exact path must be used to compute a fraction sold by any particular minute. All figures inherit the descriptive eta calibration and minute clock.
b3f3f9f88471.zh: 模型数字。<bookmark mark='a'/> 均匀切片成本21千美元，即1.6基点，标准差267千。<bookmark mark='b'/> lambda为百万分之一时成本35千，标准差178千。<bookmark mark='c'/> 连续紧迫度近似的e倍时间为19分钟，并非精确有限期半衰期；某分钟卖出比例需用精确路径计算。所有数字都承接描述性eta校准和分钟时钟。

1a11ce825b13.en: What lambda means. <bookmark mark='a'/> It has units: dollars of expected cost per squared dollar of uncertainty. <bookmark mark='b'/> At ten to the minus six, the schedule's risk term is worth about 32 thousand dollars. <bookmark mark='c'/> Read it as a certainty equivalent: what the desk would pay, in expected impact, to remove the uncertainty. Choosing lambda is choosing that price.
1a11ce825b13.zh: lambda意味着什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>它有单位：每平方美元不确定性对应的期望成本美元数。<bookmark mark='b'/>在10的负6次方时，这个时间表的风险项约值32千美元。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它理解为确定性等价：交易台愿意以期望冲击的形式付出多少，来消除不确定性。选择lambda就是选择这个价格。

7a192b3c447f.en: Compare two different quantities. <bookmark mark='a'/> The linear temporary-cost illustration gives average shortfall 1.6 basis points. <bookmark mark='b'/> A Y-equals-one square-root extrapolation gives terminal displacement 20 basis points for 1.3 percent of mean recorded volume. <bookmark mark='c'/> These use different calibration and measurement conventions. Under an ideal path c root q, average impact is two-thirds of terminal displacement, before spread and fees. Persistence, rate dependence and identification also differ. The numerical gap alone cannot attribute missing costs to persistence or validate either estimate.
7a192b3c447f.zh: 比较两种不同量。<bookmark mark='a'/> 线性暂时成本示意给平均差额1.6基点。<bookmark mark='b'/> Y为一的平方根外推，对平均记录日量1.3个百分点订单给终点位移20基点。<bookmark mark='c'/> 二者校准和测量约定不同。理想c根q路径的平均冲击为终点三分之二，尚不含价差费用。持续性、速率依赖和识别也有差异；仅看数值差不能把遗漏成本归因于持续性或验证任一估计。

21daea997775.en: A practical model template. <bookmark mark='a'/> An average-cost estimate may add half-spread, an average-impact coefficient times sigma root Q over V, and fees. Calibrate that coefficient for average shortfall; do not silently reuse a terminal-impact coefficient. <bookmark mark='b'/> Almgren and colleagues fitted rate-dependent temporary impact with exponent around three fifths under their data and conventions. <bookmark mark='c'/> A schedule and an empirical cost model can be combined, but their clocks, units, measurement targets and uncertainty must agree. The continuous shape is not automatically optimal for the empirical square-root surface.
21daea997775.zh: 实际模型模板。<bookmark mark='a'/> 平均成本估计可加半价差、平均冲击系数乘sigma根Q除V，以及费用。必须按平均差额校准系数，不能默用终点系数。<bookmark mark='b'/> Almgren等在其样本和约定下拟合速率指数约五分之三的暂时冲击。<bookmark mark='c'/> 时间表可与经验成本模型结合，但时钟、单位、目标和不确定性要一致；连续模型形状并不自动是经验平方根曲面的最优解。

245e973acbd4.en: Three extensions. <bookmark mark='a'/> With impact a power of the rate, Almgren showed the curve changes shape but still front-loads for risk. <bookmark mark='b'/> Bertsimas and Lo, earlier, minimised expected cost alone with a predictable drift: without one, the answer is TWAP. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the mean-variance schedule is static. Almgren and Julian Lorenz showed that re-optimising as prices move, selling faster after gains, does better, at the price of time-consistency.
245e973acbd4.zh: 三个推广。<bookmark mark='a'/>当冲击是速率的幂时，Almgren证明曲线形状会改变，但仍会因风险而前置。<bookmark mark='b'/>更早的Bertsimas和Lo在有可预测漂移的情况下只最小化期望成本：没有漂移时，答案就是TWAP。<bookmark mark='c'/>而均值-方差时间表是静态的。Almgren和Julian Lorenz证明，随着价格变动重新优化，在盈利之后卖得更快，效果更好，代价是失去时间一致性。

9289448a99d1.en: Beyond variance. <bookmark mark='a'/> Alexander Schied and Torsten Schöneborn showed that with exponential utility the static schedule is optimal, and with other utilities the schedule adapts to wealth. <bookmark mark='b'/> Minimising a tail measure of the shortfall front-loads more when prices can jump. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in practice desks do not choose a lambda: they set an urgency, a half-life or a participation rate, from the signal's decay and the order's size.
9289448a99d1.zh: 超越方差。<bookmark mark='a'/>Alexander Schied和Torsten Schöneborn证明，在指数效用下静态时间表是最优的，在其他效用下时间表会随财富调整。<bookmark mark='b'/>当价格可能跳跃时，最小化差额的尾部度量会更多地前置。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在实践中，交易台并不选lambda：他们根据信号的衰减和订单的规模，设定一个紧迫度、半衰期或参与率。

304bcbd2d44c.en: Quantitative pause five. In continuous Almgren-Chriss, horizon sixty minutes and lambda sigma squared over eta equals point zero one per minute squared. Find kappa, the fraction held at twenty minutes, and the exact half-life using the sinh path.
304bcbd2d44c.zh: 数值暂停题五。连续Almgren与Chriss时限六十分钟，lambda sigma平方除eta为每分钟平方零点零一。求kappa、二十分钟持仓比例，并用sinh路径求精确半衰期。

89441deeee94.en: Chapter six. Almgren and Chriss's temporary impact vanishes the instant after each trade. Real books recover over time: liquidity taken is replaced at some rate. Anna Obizhaeva and Jiang Wang built the schedule for that world, and its answer surprises.
89441deeee94.zh: 第6章。Almgren和Chriss的暂时性冲击在每笔交易后的瞬间就消失了。真实的订单簿随时间恢复：被吃掉的流动性以某个速率被补充。Anna Obizhaeva和王江为这样的世界构建了时间表，它的答案令人惊讶。

cfe95c2c9a35.en: The model. <bookmark mark='a'/> A book with depth q: a buy of size x eats the offers and lifts the ask by x over q. <bookmark mark='b'/> The displacement then heals: new offers arrive and close the gap at a rate rho, the resilience. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is Chapter four's transient impact with an exponential kernel: convex, decreasing, and allowed.
cfe95c2c9a35.zh: 模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个深度为q的订单簿：规模为x的买单吃掉卖单，把卖价抬高x除以q。<bookmark mark='b'/>这个偏移随后愈合：新的卖单到来，以速率rho填补缺口，这就是韧性。<bookmark mark='c'/>这就是第4章带指数核的暂时性冲击：凸的、递减的、被允许的。

dd73d66d37f7.en: The answer to the pause: blocks. <bookmark mark='a'/> Open with a block, while the book is undisturbed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then trade at exactly the rate at which the book recovers, so the displacement stays constant. <bookmark mark='c'/> And close with another block of the same size: after the last trade there is no future left for its impact to cost you. <bookmark mark='d'/> The cost is X squared over the depth times two plus rho T. With rho T of ten, each block is 8.3 percent of the order.
dd73d66d37f7.zh: 暂停问题的答案：整块。<bookmark mark='a'/>趁订单簿未受扰动，先整块买入。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后恰好以订单簿恢复的速率交易，让偏移保持不变。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后再整块买入同样大小：最后一笔交易之后，没有未来让它的冲击再让你付钱。<bookmark mark='d'/>成本是X的平方除以深度乘以2加rho T。当rho T为10时，每一整块是订单的8.3%。

2390412861e3.en: On a grid of two hundred dates, the numerical optimum. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two spikes, at the ends, and a flat rate between, below the steady TWAP rate. <bookmark mark='b'/> As the grid refines, the blocks and the cost converge to the formula: on a thousand dates the cost differs from it by 0.001 percent.
2390412861e3.zh: 在两百个时点的网格上，数值最优解。<bookmark mark='a'/>两端各有一个尖峰，中间是平坦的速率，低于稳定的TWAP速率。<bookmark mark='b'/>随着网格加细，整块和成本都收敛到公式：在一千个时点上，成本与公式相差0.001%。

98b823c6e3db.en: By resilience. <bookmark mark='a'/> At exactly zero resilience, the constant kernel has the same cost for every schedule of fixed total quantity; two half-order endpoint blocks are just one limiting choice, and uniqueness fails. For positive rho, exponential-kernel strict positivity gives the unique measure-valued optimum. As rho T grows, blocks shrink and cost is asymptotic to X squared over q rho T. Matching a nonzero temporary-impact coefficient requires holding one over q rho fixed while taking the fast-recovery limit; fixed q and rho tending to infinity instead makes this cost vanish.
98b823c6e3db.zh: 按恢复率比较。<bookmark mark='a'/> 恢复率恰为零时，常数核对固定总量所有时间表成本相同；两端各一半只是一个极限选择，唯一性失败。正rho时，指数核严格正性给出唯一测度最优解。rho T增加时整块缩小，成本渐近X平方除以q rho T。若快速恢复极限要匹配非零暂时系数，必须保持一除以q rho固定；固定q而rho趋无穷则成本趋零。

f21f34d2dcfe.en: A tentative displayed-depth proxy, with important limits. <bookmark mark='a'/> The code converts the first two points of a median normalized depth curve into a one-step exponential rate, clipping the ratio and using a fallback if depth overshoots. The output is 30 per second. It is not a fitted lower confidence bound or identified causal resilience. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiplying by an hour gives 108,832. <bookmark mark='c'/> Substituting this proxy into a distinct exponential-displacement model produces very small blocks. Median queue refilling and the decay of one trader's price displacement are different objects, so this substitution is only illustrative.
f21f34d2dcfe.zh: 带重要限制的可见深度代理。<bookmark mark='a'/> 代码用中位归一化深度前两点换算一步指数速率，截断比值，深度超调时使用回退值，输出每秒30。它不是拟合置信下界或已识别因果韧性。<bookmark mark='b'/> 乘一小时得到108832。<bookmark mark='c'/> 把它代入另一个指数价格位移模型会得到很小整块。队列中位回补和单个交易者的价格位移衰减不是同一对象，所以这种代入只是示意。

de99505560de.en: And with Bouchaud's power-law propagator instead of an exponential. <bookmark mark='a'/> The exponential keeps a flat rate between its blocks. <bookmark mark='b'/> The power law trades in a U: blocks at both ends, and a rate that dips in the middle, because old impact lingers longer. Against TWAP, the optimal schedule saves 10 percent of the cost under the exponential and 4 percent under the power law.
de99505560de.zh: 再用Bouchaud的幂律传播子代替指数核。<bookmark mark='a'/>指数核在整块之间保持平坦的速率。<bookmark mark='b'/>幂律则按U形交易：两端有整块，中间速率下凹，因为旧的冲击停留得更久。与TWAP相比，最优时间表在指数核下节省10%的成本，在幂律下节省4%。

f6d18d6bfc8d.en: Selected quote-grid jumps in two date files. There are 2,419 events where the mid moves at least ten ticks in a 100-millisecond grid step, separated by over thirty seconds and away from boundaries. These need not be observed message-level sweeps. <bookmark mark='a'/> Median total best-queue depth, normalized by each event's preceding-depth median, starts near 71 percent. The displayed recovery statistic is a first threshold crossing, not proof of sustained recovery. <bookmark mark='b'/> Mean signed price displacement is about 46 ticks after two minutes. Overlapping later horizons, conditional event selection and future flow matter; drift does not identify news or rule out mechanical impact. Depth recovery and price recovery are distinct statistics.
f6d18d6bfc8d.zh: 两个日期文件中选出的报价网格跳跃。中价一百毫秒变化至少十跳，共2419个事件，间隔超过三十秒并远离边界，并不必然是逐笔观测扫单。<bookmark mark='a'/> 最优两队列总深度按各事件前深度中位数归一，事件后中位值约71个百分点。恢复统计是首次越过阈值，不证明持续恢复。<bookmark mark='b'/> 两分钟平均方向价格位移约46跳。后续时限重叠、事件选择和未来流量都重要，漂移不识别新闻，也不排除机械冲击。深度恢复与价格恢复是不同统计。

9259e62a2bd7.en: Adding signals changes the optimization problem. <bookmark mark='a'/> Specify an adapted conditional price-drift forecast and its decay. <bookmark mark='b'/> Under particular linear-quadratic control assumptions, Cartea and Jaimungal, and Lehalle and Neuman, derive a base schedule plus a forecast-dependent tilt. There is no universal additive correction across all impact models. <bookmark mark='c'/> Part thirty-six's book variables are candidates for such forecasts; its contemporaneous OFI relation and limited microprice evaluation are not automatically deployable predictive alpha.
9259e62a2bd7.zh: 加入信号会改变优化问题。<bookmark mark='a'/> 指定可适应的条件价格漂移预测及其衰减。<bookmark mark='b'/> 在特定线性二次控制假设下，Cartea与Jaimungal以及Lehalle与Neuman推导基准时间表加预测相关倾斜；不是所有冲击模型都有通用加法修正。<bookmark mark='c'/> 第三十六部分订单簿变量可作候选特征，但同时OFI关系和有限微价格评估不能自动成为可部署预测收益。

eec72cdb168a.en: And other executors. <bookmark mark='a'/> When many funds trade the same way, each one's impact is everyone's cost: Pierre Cardaliaguet and Lehalle solved the equilibrium as a mean-field game, the tool of Part eight. <bookmark mark='b'/> Markus Brunnermeier and Lasse Pedersen showed how traders who learn of a forced seller sell first and buy back later: secrecy is part of execution. <bookmark mark='c'/> And public, crowded flows, like index changes, pay a recurring tax for trading with the crowd.
eec72cdb168a.zh: 还有其他执行者。<bookmark mark='a'/>当许多基金朝同一方向交易时，每一家的冲击都是所有人的成本：Pierre Cardaliaguet和Lehalle用第8部分的工具平均场博弈求解了均衡。<bookmark mark='b'/>Markus Brunnermeier和Lasse Pedersen展示了得知有被迫卖方的交易者如何先卖后买回：保密是执行的一部分。<bookmark mark='c'/>而公开的、拥挤的订单流，比如指数调整，要为与人群同向交易反复缴税。

f5d6f484bea2.en: Quantitative pause six. Sell five thousand bitcoin uniformly over sixty minutes. Price volatility is twelve dollars per bitcoin per square root minute. Integrate the squared holdings times sigma squared, and give the shortfall standard deviation in dollars. This is the continuous benchmark; a discrete convention differs slightly.
f5d6f484bea2.zh: 数值暂停题六。五千比特币在六十分钟均匀卖出，价格波动率为每比特币每平方根分钟十二美元。积分sigma平方乘持仓平方，给出美元差额标准差。这是连续基准，离散约定会略有差别。

66611a967369.en: Chapter seven. A fitted queue simulator provides a separate numerical illustration. After sixty thousand training episodes, its learner costs 52.7 total half-ticks against 50.7 for TWAP on another simulator random stream. This is a comparison within one model and training seed, with no proof of optimality and no real-market test.
66611a967369.zh: 第七章。拟合队列模拟器提供独立的数值示例。六万次训练后，另一模拟随机流中，学习者总成本52.7个半跳，TWAP为50.7。比较限定于一个模型与训练种子，没有最优性证明或真实市场测试。

cc290cbf545e.en: The literature. <bookmark mark='a'/> Yuriy Nevmyvaka, Yi Feng and Michael Kearns applied tabular reinforcement learning to Nasdaq order books in two thousand and six, and improved on simple strategies. <bookmark mark='b'/> Deep versions followed, such as Brian Ning, Franco Lin and Jaimungal's double deep Q-learning, with gains over TWAP and Almgren and Chriss reported. <bookmark mark='c'/> The catch: a learner is only as good as the market it practises in.
cc290cbf545e.zh: 文献脉络。<bookmark mark='a'/> 涅夫米瓦卡、冯与卡恩斯在2006年把表格强化学习用于纳斯达克订单簿，报告优于简单策略。<bookmark mark='b'/> 后续有深度版本，例如宁、林与贾伊蒙加尔的双重深度Q学习，并报告相对TWAP及Almgren与Chriss基准的改善。<bookmark mark='c'/> 关键限制是：学习者的结论取决于它练习的市场模型。

7977ba6d456b.en: The environment. <bookmark mark='a'/> The market is Part thirty-six's queue-reactive book, fitted to the seventeenth of May. <bookmark mark='b'/> The task: sell 20 units in 20 steps, with the rest dumped at the end. <bookmark mark='c'/> A sale eats the bid queue; each time a queue is emptied the price falls half a tick and the order walks on. That is the impact. <bookmark mark='d'/> The cost is the implementation shortfall, in half-ticks.
7977ba6d456b.zh: 环境。<bookmark mark='a'/>市场是第36部分的队列反应订单簿，用5月17日的数据拟合。<bookmark mark='b'/>任务：在20步内卖出20个单位，剩下的在最后一次性卖出。<bookmark mark='c'/>一次卖出吃掉买方队列；每当一个队列被清空，价格下跌半跳，订单继续往下吃。这就是冲击。<bookmark mark='d'/>成本是执行差额，以半跳为单位。

db4e788783af.en: The learner. <bookmark mark='a'/> It sees the step, the inventory left, and the queue imbalance in three buckets. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each step it sells nothing, one, two or four units. <bookmark mark='c'/> And it learns by Part eight's Q-learning, exploring less and less over sixty thousand episodes.
db4e788783af.zh: 学习者。<bookmark mark='a'/>它看到当前步数、剩余库存，以及分成三组的队列不平衡。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步它卖出零、一、二或四个单位。<bookmark mark='c'/>它用第8部分的Q学习来学习，在六万回合中探索越来越少。

7dc2c828c315.en: The training curve. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each point averages five hundred exploration episodes of the same fitted queue simulator. <bookmark mark='b'/> Costs are noisy and the curve approaches the TWAP reference. Training noise, finite learning and restricted state and actions can all matter. This curve alone does not show that there is nothing useful to learn, certify convergence to an optimum, or compare real-market execution quality.
7dc2c828c315.zh: 训练曲线。<bookmark mark='a'/> 每点平均同一拟合队列模拟器的五百次探索回合。<bookmark mark='b'/> 成本嘈杂，曲线接近TWAP参考。训练噪声、有限学习以及受限状态动作都可能影响结果。这条曲线不能证明无可学习结构，不能认证收敛到最优，也不能比较真实市场执行质量。

c256af8ed88e.en: Evaluation on five thousand episodes per policy, with a new simulator seed but the same fitted model. <bookmark mark='a'/> TWAP costs 50.7, Q-learning 52.7, front-loading 54.2, thin-bid selling 55.8, and immediate dumping 60.2 total half-ticks. The plus-minus values are individual Monte Carlo standard errors, not uncertainty in calibration, learning seeds or real-market performance. Reusing one starting seed does not align paths after different state-dependent actions consume different random draws; a paired-difference error is not available here.
c256af8ed88e.zh: 每策略评估五千回合，使用新模拟种子但仍是同一个拟合模型。<bookmark mark='a'/> TWAP成本50.7，Q学习52.7，前置54.2，薄买队列规则55.8，立即清仓60.2，均为总半跳。正负值是各自蒙特卡洛标准误，不含校准、训练种子或真实市场不确定性。相同起始种子不能保证状态相关动作消耗不同随机数后路径仍配对；这里没有配对差值标准误。

7dab72d62efe.en: What the profile records. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bars average the learner's chosen sales at each decision, capped by remaining inventory. The collection code does not add any forced final dump to these bars, although final liquidation is included in evaluation cost. The bar sum can therefore be below the twenty-unit parent order. The plot describes this trained policy's decisions; it does not prove that waiting is costless or the fitted market is conditionally driftless in every state.
7dab72d62efe.zh: 曲线记录什么。<bookmark mark='a'/> 柱子平均每次决策中学习者选择出售的量，以剩余库存为上限。收集代码没有把强制终端清仓加入柱子，虽然评估成本包含它。因此柱子总和可能低于二十单位母订单。图描述该训练策略的决策，不证明等待无成本，也不证明拟合市场每状态都条件无漂移。

b446608015ea.en: Interpreting the result. <bookmark mark='a'/> This learner did not beat TWAP in this particular simulator run. A state-dependent queue model may have conditional imbalance drift even when an overall symmetric distribution has zero average drift; queue resets do not establish that no exploitable structure remains. <bookmark mark='b'/> Finite learning, coarse observations, restricted actions and noise are possible explanations; the result does not isolate their causes or prove TWAP near-optimal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Improving state, impact dynamics and evaluation is a research direction requiring fresh authorization for new experiments, not a new market trial performed here.
b446608015ea.zh: 如何解释。<bookmark mark='a'/> 这位学习者在特定模拟运行中没有超过TWAP。状态相关队列即使总体对称、平均无漂移，也可能有不平衡导致的条件漂移；队列重置不能证明没有可用结构。<bookmark mark='b'/> 有限学习、粗观察、受限动作和噪声都是可能原因；结果不能单独识别原因或证明TWAP接近最优。<bookmark mark='c'/> 改善状态、冲击动态与评估是研究方向，新的实验需要新的授权，不是这里已经进行的新市场试验。

f96ddeebac13.en: Possible evaluation improvements. <bookmark mark='a'/> Common random numbers require deliberately coupled exogenous innovations, not merely setting the same seed before policies that consume different numbers of draws. Measure the variance of paired differences rather than assuming cancellation. <bookmark mark='b'/> A learner may search residual decisions around a strong analytic baseline. <bookmark mark='c'/> Richer impact dynamics need empirical validation and genuine future-market tests. These are proposals; the current evidence comes only from the unchanged original simulator computation.
f96ddeebac13.zh: 可能改善评估的方法。<bookmark mark='a'/> 公共随机数要求刻意配对外生创新，不是给消耗不同随机数的策略设置同种子。应测量配对差值方差，而非假定噪声抵消。<bookmark mark='b'/> 学习者可在强解析基准周围搜索剩余决策。<bookmark mark='c'/> 更丰富动态需要经验验证及真正未来市场测试。这些是建议，当前证据只来自未改动的原始模拟计算。

6c043c6445de.en: Designing a better experiment. <bookmark mark='a'/> A richer state: the spread, the recent imbalance, the microprice's lean, and short-term volatility. <bookmark mark='b'/> A reward with a risk penalty, so the learner faces Almgren and Chriss's trade-off. <bookmark mark='c'/> And comparisons on the same random paths with TWAP, with Almgren and Chriss at the same risk, and with a simple imbalance rule.
6c043c6445de.zh: 设计一个更好的实验。<bookmark mark='a'/>更丰富的状态：价差、近期不平衡、微观价格的偏离和短期波动率。<bookmark mark='b'/>带风险惩罚的奖励，让学习者面对Almgren和Chriss的权衡。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及在相同随机路径上与TWAP、同等风险下的Almgren-Chriss，和一条简单的不平衡规则作比较。

f5f92cb7976f.en: Quantitative pause eight. A VWAP plan allocates a thousand bitcoin according to an expected volume curve. One hour has seven point five percent expected share. Find the planned quantity and explain why forecast errors can change realized participation.
f5f92cb7976f.zh: 数值暂停题八。VWAP计划按预期成交量曲线分配一千个比特币，某小时预期占百分之七点五。求该小时计划数量，并解释预测误差为什么可能改变实际参与率。

e6634947d599.en: For the original empirical volume-curve example, a thousand-bitcoin plan allocates 74 bitcoin to the fourteen-to-fifteen UTC hour and 23 to the four-to-five UTC hour. <bookmark mark='a'/> The chosen-volume pause uses a seven-point-five-percent hour, giving seventy-five bitcoin. <bookmark mark='b'/> A VWAP plan follows expected volume. <bookmark mark='c'/> Realized participation changes when the forecast or total volume changes; following a forecast does not guarantee constant realized share.
e6634947d599.zh: 原经验成交量曲线例子中，一千比特币计划在十四至十五点UTC分配74个，四至五点分配23个。<bookmark mark='a'/> 指定数值暂停题使用百分之七点五小时，因此为七十五个。<bookmark mark='b'/> VWAP计划跟随预期成交量。<bookmark mark='c'/> 预测或总成交量变化时实际参与率会变化，跟随预测并不保证实际份额恒定。

19fc589d2889.en: Chapter eight. The theory becomes products: a handful of execution algorithms that every broker sells, the routers beneath them, and transaction-cost analysis, which tells the client what it all cost.
19fc589d2889.zh: 第8章。理论变成了产品：每家券商都出售的几种执行算法，它们之下的路由器，以及告诉客户这一切花了多少钱的交易成本分析。

5dd3a68ec295.en: The menu. <bookmark mark='a'/> TWAP: equal slices in time, Bertsimas and Lo's answer for a risk-neutral trader. <bookmark mark='b'/> VWAP: slices in proportion to the volume expected at each time of day, so it tracks the volume-weighted price. <bookmark mark='c'/> POV: a fixed share of the volume actually traded, so the end time is uncertain. <bookmark mark='d'/> And IS, implementation shortfall: Almgren and Chriss's front-loaded schedule, set by an urgency.
5dd3a68ec295.zh: 菜单。<bookmark mark='a'/>TWAP：按时间等分，是Bertsimas和Lo给风险中性交易者的答案。<bookmark mark='b'/>VWAP：按一天中各时刻预期成交量的比例分配，所以它跟踪成交量加权平均价格。<bookmark mark='c'/>POV：按实际成交量的固定份额交易，所以结束时间不确定。<bookmark mark='d'/>以及IS，执行差额算法：Almgren和Chriss的前置时间表，由紧迫度决定。

87179394d65a.en: Bitcoin's volume curve, from every minute of twenty twenty-three on the perpetual. <bookmark mark='a'/> Crypto never closes, but it has a day: a trough of 2.3 percent of the volume in the hour from 4:00, and a peak of 7.5 percent from 15:00, when New York opens and American data come out. <bookmark mark='b'/> TWAP is the dashed line, the same in every hour. VWAP follows the bars.
87179394d65a.zh: 比特币的成交量曲线，来自2023年永续合约的每一分钟。<bookmark mark='a'/>加密市场从不收盘，但它也有一天的节奏：从4点开始的那个小时是低谷，占成交量的2.3%；从15点开始的那个小时是高峰，占7.5%，那时纽约开盘、美国数据公布。<bookmark mark='b'/>TWAP是那条虚线，每个小时都一样。VWAP跟随柱状图。

d1de0382fffa.en: Two more calendars. <bookmark mark='a'/> The week: weekend minutes trade about 52 percent of the volume of weekday ones. <bookmark mark='b'/> So a VWAP algorithm is only as good as its volume forecast. <bookmark mark='c'/> And events, index rebalances, expiries and data releases, bend the curve; in American stocks the closing auction alone can hold a tenth of the day's volume.
d1de0382fffa.zh: 另外两个日历。<bookmark mark='a'/>一周：周末每分钟的成交量约为工作日的52%。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以VWAP算法的好坏取决于它的成交量预测。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有事件，指数调整、到期日和数据公布，会扭曲曲线；在美国股票中，仅收盘集合竞价就可能占一天成交量的十分之一。

0a7d7701c88b.en: Participation and duration. <bookmark mark='a'/> A size-only terminal-impact formula holds its prediction fixed as duration changes, because duration is absent by assumption. <bookmark mark='b'/> For constant market volume rate V-dot, trading at share pi gives rate pi V-dot and completion time Q over pi V-dot. A daily total volume must first be converted to a rate. <bookmark mark='c'/> Actual participation changes may affect impact, adverse selection and information leakage. <bookmark mark='d'/> In a diffusive constant-rate illustration, timing-risk scale grows with root T. These modeling assumptions explain the comparison; the size-only formula alone does not establish that slower execution is equally costly.
0a7d7701c88b.zh: 参与率与时长。<bookmark mark='a'/> 仅含规模的终点冲击公式在改变时长时保持预测不变，因为假设中根本没有时长。<bookmark mark='b'/> 恒定市场成交速率V点下，参与率pi给交易速率pi V点，完成时长Q除以pi V点。日总量必须先换算为速率。<bookmark mark='c'/> 实际参与率变化可能影响冲击、逆向选择及信息泄露。<bookmark mark='d'/> 恒速扩散示例的时机风险按根T增加。这些假设解释比较，仅含规模的公式不能独立证明慢交易成本一样。

ed87cf070882.en: The close. <bookmark mark='a'/> Stock exchanges end the day with an auction, one price for every market-on-close and limit-on-close order; index funds rebalance there. <bookmark mark='b'/> The exchanges publish the auction's imbalance beforehand, and liquidity providers trade against it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Crypto has no close: its benchmarks are reference rates computed from several venues over a window, which an executor tracks like a short VWAP.
ed87cf070882.zh: 收盘。<bookmark mark='a'/>股票交易所以一场集合竞价结束一天，所有市价收盘单和限价收盘单按同一个价格成交；指数基金在那里调仓。<bookmark mark='b'/>交易所事先公布竞价的不平衡，流动性提供者针对它交易。<bookmark mark='c'/>加密市场没有收盘：它的基准是在一个时间窗口内从多个交易场所计算的参考价格，执行者像跟踪短时VWAP一样跟踪它。

7ce7e207bd09.en: Beneath the schedule. <bookmark mark='a'/> A smart order router splits each child order across venues, by displayed size, fees, fill probability and the risk of being picked off. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each child chooses to rest, cheaper but slower and adversely selected, as Part thirty-six measured, or to cross and pay the spread. <bookmark mark='c'/> And dark pools hide the order, which helps only if the pool's other users are not reading it.
7ce7e207bd09.zh: 时间表之下。<bookmark mark='a'/>智能订单路由器按显示的数量、手续费、成交概率和被狙击的风险，把每笔子订单分配到各个交易场所。<bookmark mark='b'/>每笔子订单要么挂单，更便宜但更慢，并且会遭遇第36部分测得的逆向选择；要么跨越价差直接成交。<bookmark mark='c'/>暗池能隐藏订单，但只有当池中其他用户没在读它时才有帮助。

942f42f8eefa.en: And in crypto. <bookmark mark='a'/> There is no consolidated quote and no order-protection rule: Bitcoin trades on dozens of exchanges, and routing among them is the trader's own problem. <bookmark mark='b'/> The same exposure trades as spot and as perpetual futures, and an executor can split across both, paying the basis and the funding. <bookmark mark='c'/> And every venue holds collateral, a counterparty risk that Part thirty-nine prices.
942f42f8eefa.zh: 再看加密市场。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有合并报价，也没有订单保护规则：比特币在几十个交易所交易，在它们之间路由是交易者自己的问题。<bookmark mark='b'/>同样的敞口以现货和永续合约两种形式交易，执行者可以在两者之间分配，付出基差和资金费率。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个交易场所都持有抵押品，这是第39部分要定价的对手方风险。

bcfe326d7d8e.en: An illustrative average-cost estimate. <bookmark mark='a'/> A hundred and fifty million dollars is half a percent of thirty billion dollars of daily volume. <bookmark mark='b'/> Choose an average-impact coefficient of one and daily return volatility 1.2 percent; the impact estimate is 8.5 basis points. <bookmark mark='c'/> Half a point-three basis-point spread and point-two basis-point fees give 8.8 basis points total. This coefficient is explicitly for average shortfall, rather than a terminal peak. The figures are chosen inputs and omit estimation uncertainty and rate dependence.
bcfe326d7d8e.zh: 平均成本示意。<bookmark mark='a'/> 一亿五千万美元是三百亿美元日成交量的百分之零点五。<bookmark mark='b'/> 选择平均冲击系数一及日收益波动率百分之一点二，冲击估计8.5基点。<bookmark mark='c'/> 加零点三基点价差的一半及零点二基点费用，总计8.8基点。这个系数明确对应平均差额而非终点峰值。数字是指定输入，省略估计不确定性与速率依赖。

f987c3763689.en: Transaction-cost analysis. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fix decision and arrival timestamps and price sources in advance. The first fill is endogenous to an executor's choices and is not an immune benchmark. <bookmark mark='b'/> Report signed shortfall, fees and the convention for unfilled shares. Accounting decompositions do not separately identify news and mechanical impact. <bookmark mark='c'/> Use signed fill markouts with the same spread and fee convention. <bookmark mark='d'/> Compare costs across suitable orders with model uncertainty, dependence and selection in view. A large sample does not automatically remove systematic bias.
f987c3763689.zh: 交易成本分析。<bookmark mark='a'/> 提前固定决策、到达时间戳和价格来源。首笔成交受执行者选择影响，不能免于操控。<bookmark mark='b'/> 报告带方向差额、费用及未成交标价约定。会计分解不能分别识别消息和机械冲击。<bookmark mark='c'/> 用一致价差费用约定计算带方向成交后标价。<bookmark mark='d'/> 跨适当订单比较时考虑模型不确定性、依赖和选择；大样本不会自动消除系统偏差。

f95ece7496ba.en: A worked example. A buy of a hundred thousand shares is decided at a hundred dollars. <bookmark mark='a'/> The algorithm starts five cents higher: delay. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ninety thousand shares are filled at an average of a hundred dollars thirty: the execution cost, spread, impact and timing together. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ten thousand are never filled, and the price ends at a hundred dollars sixty: the opportunity cost. <bookmark mark='d'/> In all, 33 basis points of the order. Notice that the unfilled tenth cost more than the delay.
f95ece7496ba.zh: 一个完整的例子。在100美元时决定买入十万股。<bookmark mark='a'/>算法在高出五美分的价格开始：延迟成本。<bookmark mark='b'/>九万股以平均100.30美元成交：执行成本，包括价差、冲击和时机。<bookmark mark='c'/>一万股始终没有成交，价格最终停在100.60美元：机会成本。<bookmark mark='d'/>合计为订单的33个基点。注意，未成交的那十分之一比延迟花得还多。

a5fd30f52859.en: And a warning about benchmarks. <bookmark mark='a'/> VWAP can be gamed: a large order moves the VWAP itself, so beating it can mean only that the order was big. <bookmark mark='b'/> A closing-price benchmark invites trading at the close, where the order helps set the price. <bookmark mark='c'/> And a broker judged against VWAP will trade VWAP even when the client's alpha decays fast. The benchmark should match the urgency.
a5fd30f52859.zh: 关于基准的一个警告。<bookmark mark='a'/>VWAP可以被操纵：大订单本身会推动VWAP，所以跑赢它可能只说明订单很大。<bookmark mark='b'/>收盘价基准会诱使人在收盘时交易，而订单本身参与决定那个价格。<bookmark mark='c'/>以VWAP考核的券商，即使客户的阿尔法衰减很快，也会按VWAP交易。基准应当与紧迫度相匹配。

40f0d79703a2.en: Quantitative pause nine. The parent quantity is two percent of daily volume and the market volume rate is constant. Compare five-percent with twenty-percent participation. Compute the completion times in days and the ratio of square-root-time risk scales. State the size-only impact assumption separately.
40f0d79703a2.zh: 数值暂停题九。母订单为日成交量百分之二，市场成交速率恒定。比较百分之五与百分之二十参与率，计算完成天数及平方根时间风险之比，并单独说明仅含规模的冲击假设。

b8179857e8b4.en: An execution-choice example. <bookmark mark='a'/> A fading signal can make delay costly, separately from price variance. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare an urgency-based shortfall schedule or a higher participation target with the incremental rate-dependent costs. A size-only square-root formula cannot settle that choice. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fix a decision or arrival benchmark independently of the executor, and judge all costs and uncertainties against the same convention.
b8179857e8b4.zh: 执行选择示例。<bookmark mark='a'/> 衰减信号可能使延迟昂贵，这不同于价格方差。<bookmark mark='b'/> 将基于紧迫度的执行差额时间表或更高参与目标，与新增速率相关成本比较。仅含规模的平方根公式不能决定这个选择。<bookmark mark='c'/> 独立固定决策或到达基准，以同一约定比较所有成本与不确定性。

19f5ceff6239.en: Chapter nine. Rule thirty-seven is a proposed execution research protocol. An order should carry a cost estimate, uncertainty, a schedule and a fixed benchmark, followed by an honest record of execution. This lesson does not deploy a trading system or approve a signal, capacity limit or broker.
19f5ceff6239.zh: 第九章。第三十七条规则是提出的执行研究流程。订单应携带成本估计、不确定性、时间表及固定基准，之后诚实记录执行。本课不部署交易系统，也不批准信号、容量限制或经纪商。

50211871a134.en: The illustrative research sheet. <bookmark mark='a'/> A same-window aggregate-flow slope, finite-grid latent-book exponents, a descriptive propagator fit, assumed Almgren-Chriss costs, exponential-kernel blocks, and simulator-policy averages. They answer different questions with different clocks and uncertainties. Reading them together does not identify a causal cost model or validate an executable strategy.
50211871a134.zh: 示意研究表。<bookmark mark='a'/> 同窗口总体流量斜率、有限网格潜在簿指数、描述性传播子拟合、假设的AC成本、指数核整块，以及模拟策略均值。它们回答不同问题，有不同时钟和不确定性。把它们放在一起不等于识别因果成本模型或验证可执行策略。

35f5e1666b53.en: A simplified break-even illustration. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assume ten basis points of expected alpha for one trading leg, before costs. <bookmark mark='b'/> Set an average-cost square-root coefficient to one, and omit spread, fees, other legs and uncertainty. <bookmark mark='c'/> The resulting threshold is about 35 million dollars under this recorded-volume and volatility calibration. It is not an optimal position size or an approved capacity limit; round-trip costs and a margin for error would lower the allowable scale.
35f5e1666b53.zh: 简化盈亏平衡示意。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设单腿预期收益十基点，尚未扣成本。<bookmark mark='b'/> 平均成本平方根系数设一，省略价差、费用、其他交易腿和不确定性。<bookmark mark='c'/> 在这个记录量与波动率校准下阈值约35百万美元。它不是最优仓位或已批准容量；往返成本和误差余量都会降低可用规模。

07a090d10775.en: A proposed order record. <bookmark mark='a'/> Before: expected volume, a convention-specific average-cost estimate with uncertainty, signal decay and schedule. <bookmark mark='b'/> During: participation and actual fills against plan; book features need separate predictive validation before use as alpha. <bookmark mark='c'/> After: fixed-benchmark signed shortfall, fees, unfilled-share marks and subsequent markouts. Pool appropriate samples with dependence and selection controls. This is a research protocol, not evidence that a live system currently records or trades this way.
07a090d10775.zh: 提出的订单记录。<bookmark mark='a'/> 交易前写预期成交量、特定约定平均成本估计及不确定性、信号衰减与时间表。<bookmark mark='b'/> 交易中看参与率及实际成交相对计划；订单簿特征作为alpha前还需独立预测验证。<bookmark mark='c'/> 交易后记录固定基准带方向差额、费用、未成交标价及后续标价。在控制依赖和选择的适当样本中合并。这是研究流程，不是实盘系统已经如此记录交易的证据。

dd150aa29aa0.en: The same illustrative one-leg break-even curve. <bookmark mark='a'/> Average impact under the assumed Y-equals-one convention rises with dollar order size. <bookmark mark='b'/> The ten-basis-point line crosses near 35 million dollars. This is a model threshold with fixed inputs, not a forecast that trades left of the dot profit or that any deployed portfolio has such a size. Net profitability also depends on all other costs, alpha estimation, exits and uncertainty.
dd150aa29aa0.zh: 同一单腿盈亏平衡曲线。<bookmark mark='a'/> 假设Y为一的平均冲击随美元订单量增加。<bookmark mark='b'/> 十基点线在约35百万美元相交。这是固定输入的模型阈值，不预测圆点左边必然获利，也不宣称部署组合采用该规模。净利润还取决于其他成本、alpha估计、退出及不确定性。

18b0a957bda3.en: Chapter two's latent book. Each step, the density diffuses by a discrete Laplacian; while the order runs, a source at the price removes offers; and the price is wherever the density crosses zero. Ten lines, and the square root comes out.
18b0a957bda3.zh: 第2章的潜在订单簿。每一步，密度按离散拉普拉斯算子扩散；订单执行期间，价格处的一个源移除卖单；价格就是密度穿过零的地方。十行代码，平方根就出来了。

b6d07b27f509.en: Chapter five's schedule: the urgency kappa from the hyperbolic cosine, the holdings as a hyperbolic sine, and the expected cost and variance of the shortfall.
b6d07b27f509.zh: 第5章的时间表：由双曲余弦得到紧迫度kappa，持仓是双曲正弦，以及差额的期望成本和方差。

7faf1165f401.en: Chapters four and six. Build the matrix of the kernel at every pair of dates, solve it against a vector of ones, and scale to the order's size: the discrete Fredholm condition. And the closed form it converges to for an exponential kernel, two lines.
7faf1165f401.zh: 第4章和第6章。构造核在每一对时点上的矩阵，对全1向量求解，再按订单规模缩放：离散的弗雷德霍姆条件。以及对指数核它所收敛到的闭式解，两行。

5bdf2ff03fea.en: And Chapter three's fit: the sign autocorrelation and the cross-correlation of price changes with past signs, a Toeplitz system solved, and a cumulative sum. The propagator is what remains of a trade's impact.
5bdf2ff03fea.zh: 还有第3章的拟合：方向自相关，以及价格变化与过去方向的互相关，解一个托普利茨方程组，再累加。传播子就是一笔成交的冲击还剩下的部分。

ba308de1b815.en: And Chapter seven's market order. While units remain, take what the best bid holds, at half a tick below the mid; when the queue is emptied the mid falls half a tick and new queues are drawn. Impact, in nine lines.
ba308de1b815.zh: 还有第7章的市价单。只要还有剩余单位，就吃掉最优买价处的数量，价格比中间价低半跳；队列被清空时，中间价下跌半跳，并重新抽取队列。冲击，九行代码。

991bc984b657.en: The tools this part adds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Measurement; the latent book; the schedules; and the learning environment. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the thirty-seventh rule. Every order reaches the market with a pre-trade cost from the square root, a schedule matched to its signal's urgency, and a benchmark at its arrival price. Every impact model is checked for no dynamic arbitrage. And every learned executor is judged first against TWAP.
